## High-Level System Architecture (Original) {.centered-flowchart .left-nodes}

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {
  'theme': 'dark',
  'themeVariables': {
    'fontSize': '15px',
    'fontFamily': 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif'
  },
  'flowchart': {
    'nodeSpacing': 28,
    'rankSpacing': 38,
    'padding': 16
  }
}}%%
flowchart LR
    subgraph Dev["Phase 1: Local Build"]
        direction TB
        Src["<b>Source Code</b><ul><li>TypeScript modules<li>CSS & Assets</ul>"]
        BuildEngine["<b>Node.js + npm + Vite</b><ul><li>tsc typechecks<li>Vite bundles & minifies<li>Chunks MapLibre & PMTiles</ul>"]
        Dist["<b>Production Bundle (dist/)</b><ul><li>index.html (SHA stamp)<li>Optimized JS & CSS<li>Vector tiles & GeoJSON</ul>"]
        Src --> BuildEngine --> Dist
    end

    subgraph Hosting["Phase 2: Pages Hosting"]
        direction TB
        GHA["<b>GitHub Actions (deploy.yml)</b><ul><li>Checks out commit & gates<li>Uploads dist/ artifact<li>Publishes to Pages</ul>"]
        CDN["<b>GitHub Pages CDN</b><ul><li>Global HTTPS hosting<li>HTTP Range-request support</ul>"]
        GHA --> CDN
    end

    subgraph Client["Phase 3: Client Browser"]
        direction TB
        Browser["<b>Visitor Browser</b><ul><li>Loads HTML, JS, CSS from CDN<li>MapLibre GL JS (WebGL GPU)<li>Streams .pmtiles on demand<li>Public APIs (USGS, NIFC, NOAA)</ul>"]
    end

    Dist --> GHA
    CDN --> Browser
```


## High-Level System Architecture (Top Down Flow) {.centered-flowchart .left-nodes}

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {
  'theme': 'dark',
  'themeVariables': {
    'fontSize': '14.5px',
    'fontFamily': 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif'
  },
  'flowchart': {
    'nodeSpacing': 26,
    'rankSpacing': 22,
    'padding': 12
  }
}}%%
flowchart TB
    subgraph Dev ["Phase 1: Local Build"]
        direction LR
        Src["<b>Source Code</b><ul><li>TypeScript modules<li>CSS & Assets</ul>"]
        BuildEngine["<b>Node.js + npm + Vite</b><ul><li>tsc typechecks<li>Vite bundles & minifies<li>Chunks MapLibre & PMTiles</ul>"]
        Dist["<b>Production Bundle (dist/)</b><ul><li>index.html (SHA stamp)<li>Optimized JS & CSS<li>Vector tiles & GeoJSON</ul>"]
        Src --> BuildEngine --> Dist
    end

    subgraph Hosting ["Phase 2: Pages Hosting"]
        direction LR
        GHA["<b>GitHub Actions (deploy.yml)</b><ul><li>Checks out commit & gates<li>Uploads dist/ artifact<li>Publishes to Pages</ul>"]
        CDN["<b>GitHub Pages CDN</b><ul><li>Global HTTPS hosting<li>HTTP Range-request support</ul>"]
        GHA --> CDN
    end

    subgraph Client ["Phase 3: Client Browser"]
        direction LR
        Browser["<b>Visitor Browser</b><ul><li>Loads HTML, JS, CSS from CDN<li>MapLibre GL JS (WebGL GPU)<li>Streams .pmtiles on demand<li>Public APIs (USGS, NIFC, NOAA)</ul>"]
    end

    Dev ==> Hosting ==> Client
```

## High-Level System Architecture (Organic) {.centered-flowchart .left-nodes}

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {
  'theme': 'dark',
  'themeVariables': {
    'fontSize': '14px',
    'fontFamily': 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif'
  },
  'flowchart': {
    'rankSpacing': 16,
    'nodeSpacing': 36,
    'padding': 12,
    'curve': 'basis'
  }
}}%%
flowchart TB
    %% Apex Top
    Dev(["💻 <b>TypeScript & Map Source</b><ul><li>MapLibre UI & signals<li>Layer styles & configs</ul>"])

    %% Left Column: Build & Edge CDN (Vertical)
    subgraph ColBuild ["Build & Edge CDN"]
        direction TB
        SpacerB["<div style='height:1px;line-height:1px;font-size:1px'></div>"]
        Build(["⚙️ <b>Vite + npm Engine</b><ul><li>Strict tsc typecheck<li>Minifies & chunks assets</ul>"])
        CDN{{"🌐 <b>GitHub Pages Edge</b><ul><li>Global HTTPS CDN<li>HTTP Range-request support</ul>"}}
        SpacerB ~~~ Build
        Build ==>|compiles| CDN
    end

    %% Right Column: Community & Telemetry (Vertical)
    subgraph ColData ["Community & Telemetry"]
        direction TB
        SpacerD["<div style='height:1px;line-height:1px;font-size:1px'></div>"]
        Tribal(["🌲 <b>Tribal Climate Partners</b><ul><li>Co-design requirements<li>Hazard indicator zones</ul>"])
        Feeds[("📡 <b>Live Remote Feeds</b><ul><li>USGS streamflow telemetry<li>NIFC wildfire<li>NOAA drought</ul>")]
        SpacerD ~~~ Tribal
        Tribal ==>|metrics & zones| Feeds
    end

    %% Bottom Subgraph: Client WebGL Execution
    Browser(["🖥️ <b>Visitor Browser (Client GPU)</b><ul><li>MapLibre GL JS (WebGL GPU)<li>Streams vector tiles on demand<li>serverless, zero upkeep</ul>"])

    %% Connections from Dev
    Dev ==>|npm run build| Build
    Dev ==>|partner alignment| Tribal

    %% Connections from CDN and ColData to Browser
    CDN ==>|streams bundle & tiles| Browser
    Feeds ==>|direct browser queries| Browser

    %% Closed loop feedback (preserves top-down DAG ranking)
    Browser -.->|field insights & telemetry| Dev

    %% Subgraph Styling
    style ColBuild fill:none,stroke:#6366f1,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray: 4 4,rx:12,ry:12
    style ColData fill:none,stroke:#3b82f6,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray: 4 4,rx:12,ry:12

    %% Node Styling
    style Dev fill:#1e293b,stroke:#38bdf8,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc
    style Build fill:#1e1e38,stroke:#818cf8,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc
    style CDN fill:#0f2937,stroke:#2dd4bf,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc
    style Browser fill:#0d3326,stroke:#34d399,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc
    style Feeds fill:#382414,stroke:#fb923c,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc
    style Tribal fill:#27272a,stroke:#a1a1aa,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc

    %% Spacers
    style SpacerB fill:none,stroke:none,color:transparent
    style SpacerD fill:none,stroke:none,color:transparent
```
